summary: Guardforce AI Co., Ltd., a Singapore-domiciled foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on 2026-09-23 containing its interim financial statements for the period ended 2026-06-30. The filing is a routine semi-annual reporting obligation under the 1934 Act, not a special situation; it includes segment data for AI Robotics, Secured Logistics and Smart Retail, plus a share repurchase program and an ATM agreement referenced in the XBRL. No transaction, stake, price or board recommendation is stated. Watch for follow-on capital-markets activity through the ATM or buyback.
